text.p: Shares in Filipacchi Media were suspended, limit-down, on Thursday after Lagardere announced an agreement to combine its media activities with those of Filipacchi.
The shares, halted at 1,404 francs after falling 10 percent, were due to resume trading at 1010 GMT, the French stockmarkets association SBF said.

Lagardere announced on Wednesday that Lagardere SCA would acquire 39 percent of NEMM, which holds 49.7 percent of Filipacchi Medias. Lagardere would bring to Filipacchi Medias its 66 percent holding in Hachette Filippachi Presse, and Filippachi Medias would absorb NEMM.
"On the basis of provisional estimates, the capital of Hachette Filipacchi Medias would be 66 percent held by Lagardere SCA," it said in a statement.
Finance director Philippe Camus told reporters on Wednesday the deal would cost Lagardere over 700 million francs and was based on a valuation of 1,200 francs per share for Filipacchi.
"We're not going to keep a stock at 1,400 francs that's worth 1,200," a trader said.
